text: As I step into this modern, glass-encased space, I am struck by a sense of curiosity. The clean lines and transparent walls make me feel both exposed and welcome, as if invited into a hive of intellect and innovation. Inside, the bold colors and sharp graphics of the R+D wall spark further intrigue. Here, I am reminded of the ceaseless human drive to question, to imagine, and to build. I feel at once small and significant—a participant in a vast, ever-unfolding process of discovery.
